sections.Profile:
"Skill Pool" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Games, Inc. in June 1963. Designed by Steve Kordek, the game features a billiards theme, incorporating pool ball targets that players aim to hit in sequence to maximize their score.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Pool (Billiards), Original Theme
sections.Editions: - Skill Pool: 2,250 made, released 1963-06-01, model number 283
